tools.name: trace
tools.title: Trace
tools.description: Show what a code target is and how it connects. target is a name, a repository-relative path, path:line or a stable id. A name with more than one definition gives the candidates. A function, method or class gives its signature, callers by evidence tier, callees, tests and last change. A file gives its declarations, imports, importers, tests and import cycles. A folder gives its tree. Each section shows how many rows it hides, and more shows one section in full. more=body gives the numbered body. more=similar lists the symbols that share callers with the target. A list of targets gives one card per target in one call.

target.description: A name, a path, path:line or a stable id. A list traces each one.

more.description: One section to show in full.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search the text of the repository files, or list files by name. pattern is a regular expression in ripgrep syntax. Without pattern, the answer lists the files that files matches. Paths are relative to the root. Matches are grouped by file and by enclosing symbol, with its stable id: give the id to trace. Lock, vendored and minified files show as count lines. Use search for literals, messages, config keys and patterns. Use trace for a name that you know.

pattern.description: A regular expression, matched line by line. Omit it to list files.

files.description: A glob on repository-relative paths, such as **/*.rs or src/{a,b}/**.

path.description: A repository-relative file or folder. Default: the root.

context.description: Lines shown before and after each match. Default 0.

limit.description: Maximum match lines or file rows. Default 100.
